question: Does RoBERTa outperform BERT?
title: Resolving the Scope of Speculation and Negation using Transformer-Based Architectures
answer_rationale: Text 2 and Text 3 state that XLNet consistently outperforms RoBERTa in the tasks studied, including negation detection and scope resolution, contrary to popular opinion. This implies RoBERTa does not outperform BERT in these contexts, as XLNet outperforms both.
